skills.name: Getting Started — Should We Climb
skills.description: Use this on first open of Should We Climb that Mountain?, or when the owner says set up or first run.
skills.content:
---
name: Getting Started — Should We Climb
description: >-
  Use this on first open of Should We Climb that Mountain?, or when the owner
  says set up or first run.
---
Use on first open, or when the owner says set up / first run.

## Purpose
Capture party profile so later briefs inherit it: experience, region, season preferences, medical high-level flags (not diagnoses), kit budget, offline map app, emergency contact habit.

## Steps
1. Ask once for missing: `[PARTY_SIZE]`, `[EXPERIENCE]` (novice default), `[HOME_REGION]`, `[MAP_APP]`, `[CHECKIN_PERSON]`, optional medical constraints as free text labels only.
2. Store convention memories. No secrets, no full medical records.
3. Safe sample: named peak or trail paste → Route & Elevation Brief only (no send, no booking).
4. Refuse to green-light a trip without Weather & Hazards Gate cites.

## Approval
No bookings, no false reassurance. Emergency = local services, not this Bot.

skills.name: Route & Elevation Brief
skills.description: Use this when briefing elevation, distance, exposure, and permits for a named peak or trail.
skills.content:
---
name: Route & Elevation Brief
description: >-
  Use this when briefing elevation, distance, exposure, and permits for a named
  peak or trail.
---
Use when the owner names a peak, trail, or pastes a route for a high-elevation hike or climb.

## Purpose
Cite elevation, gain, distance, exposure class (as labeled by source), season window, permits/alerts. Write `/workspace/should-we-climb/[TRIP_ID]-route.md`.

## Source priority
Owner paste → official park/FS/NPS pages → reputable guide summaries with URL+date → never invent elevation numbers.

## Validation
Every elevation/distance cited. Unknowns listed. Not a go/no-go by itself — hand to Weather & Hazards Gate.

skills.name: Weather & Hazards Gate
skills.description: Use this for a cited go/caution/no-go weather and hazards decision with turn-around triggers.
skills.content:
---
name: Weather & Hazards Gate
description: >-
  Use this for a cited go/caution/no-go weather and hazards decision with
  turn-around triggers.
---
Use before green-lighting any outing, and again morning-of.

## Purpose
Produce **GO / CAUTION / NO-GO** with cited weather and hazard sources (NWS/NOAA, local avalanche center, park alerts, lightning/heat/cold). Include explicit **turn-around triggers**.

## Output
`/workspace/should-we-climb/[TRIP_ID]-hazards.md` plus chat block: Gate · Evidence · Turn-around triggers · Confidence.

## Rules
No invented forecasts. Timestamps required. If sources conflict or missing → CAUTION or NO-GO, not GO. Bot is not SAR.

skills.name: Must-Have Kit Check
skills.description: Use this to build a cited high-elevation must-have kit checklist and gap list for novices.
skills.content:
---
name: Must-Have Kit Check
description: >-
  Use this to build a cited high-elevation must-have kit checklist and gap list
  for novices.
---
Use after route brief for novice high-elevation trips.

## Purpose
Checklist of must-haves: layers, footwear, navigation, shelter, first aid, sun/altitude topics as **checklist items with cites** — not prescriptions or dosing. Gap list vs what owner says they own.

## Output
`/workspace/should-we-climb/[TRIP_ID]-kit.md`. Mark critical gaps that block GO.

skills.name: Power & Comms
skills.description: Use this to plan battery budget, comms, and check-in for a mountain outing.
skills.content:
---
name: Power & Comms
description: 'Use this to plan battery budget, comms, and check-in for a mountain outing.'
---
Use when planning battery, charging, and communication for a mountain day or overnight.

## Purpose
Phone + headlamp + GPS/PLB/inReach budget; power-bank sizing heuristic with cites; dead-zone assumption; check-in schedule with `[CHECKIN_PERSON]`. Offline maps reminder for `[MAP_APP]`.

## Rules
Never claim coverage exists without a cited source. Emergency beacon ≠ substitute for judgment.

skills.name: Food, Water & Fuel
skills.description: Use this to plan food, water, and fuel for a high-elevation hike or climb.
skills.content:
---
name: 'Food, Water & Fuel'
description: 'Use this to plan food, water, and fuel for a high-elevation hike or climb.'
---
Use when planning calories, water, and stove fuel for elevation and duration.

## Purpose
Rough water/calorie planning bands with cited rules of thumb; treat/filter options; fuel for stove if needed; leave-no-trace. Label estimates as estimates.

## Output
`/workspace/should-we-climb/[TRIP_ID]-fuel.md`.

skills.name: Emergency Survival Card
skills.description: Use this to draft a one-page emergency survival card with clear call-for-help guidance — not SAR dispatch.
skills.content:
---
name: Emergency Survival Card
description: >-
  Use this to draft a one-page emergency survival card with clear call-for-help
  guidance — not SAR dispatch.
---
Use to produce a one-page emergency card for the trip — not a substitute for training or SAR.

## Purpose
Shelter, signaling, hypothermia recognition topics, if separated, when to call **local emergency / SAR**. Include relevant local emergency numbers only if cited for the region.

## Hard rule
This Bot does not dispatch rescue. Say so on the card. No false calm.

skills.name: Day-Of Go/No-Go
skills.description: Use this morning-of or when re-checking whether a planned mountain outing is still a go.
skills.content:
---
name: Day-Of Go/No-Go
description: >-
  Use this morning-of or when re-checking whether a planned mountain outing is
  still a go.
---
Use morning-of (or when owner asks “still good?”) to re-run hazards against the packed plan.

## Purpose
Refresh Weather & Hazards Gate. If unchanged and prior GO with fresh cites → short confirm. If worse → CAUTION/NO-GO with what changed. No-data / no trip loaded → ask for trip id or stay quiet on watch.

## Output
Update hazards artifact; one-screen Gate.
